The plate looks like a side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. Two fresh rice-paper rolls sit on it, each about 11-12 cm long and 3.5 cm in diameter. That gives each roll a volume of about 110 cm³, but the filling is loose, so I estimate each at roughly 55-60 g.

Each roll contains shrimp, lettuce, and probably some vermicelli, all wrapped in rice paper. Fresh summer rolls usually run about 120-150 kcal per 100 g. Lettuce is visible in them, but the rolls are cooked or assembled items rather than a raw salad, so I'm not marking them as greens.

I'm listing the two rolls as separate items, since each has a slightly different mix of filling.
